---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or editing pages for Dera Crunch, a fictional Pakistani fried-chicken fast-food brand.
---

1. The brand is "Dera Crunch". Its tagline is "Crunch Hai Toh Maza Hai". Show both in the header and the hero.
2. Tone: warm, cheeky and family-friendly, in simple English with light Roman Urdu such as "Maza aa gaya".
3. Colours: mustard #F2A900, charcoal #1F1F1F, cream background #FFF6E5, chilli accent #C8381E. Use no other colours.
4. Fonts: Poppins Bold for headings and Inter for body text, both from Google Fonts.
5. Every page has a header with the brand name and links to all pages, and a footer with the tagline and the line "Fictional student project".
6. The home page has a hero section with a call-to-action button, a menu preview and an about section.
7. The menu has eight items in three categories: Chicken, Burgers, and Sides and Drinks. Each item shows a name, a short description and a price.
8. Write prices as "Rs. 1,290": the Rs. prefix, comma separators, no decimals.
9. Write dates as "23 Nov 2026" and phone numbers as 03XX-XXXXXXX. Any form must check that a phone number has exactly 11 digits.
10. Never use the name, logo, images or slogans of any real company or restaurant chain, and never claim real branches or real deals.
